mentions.name: Intelligent AI form-filling tool
mentions.description: An intelligent AI form-filling tool that automates filling out complicated spreadsheets, aimed at helping finance customs officers and research workers save time for thinking and creative work. The project is in its early stages and the builder is seeking feedback from users.
mentions.problem: Complicated spreadsheets consume time that finance customs officers and research workers could spend on thinking and creative work.
mentions.audience: Finance customs officers and research workers who are troubled by complicated spreadsheets
mentions.source_excerpt: I created an intelligent AI form-filling tool, hope to help finance customs officers and research workers who are troubled by complicated spreadsheets, enabling them to have more time for thinking and creative work.

evidence.value: I created an intelligent AI form-filling tool, hope to help finance customs officers and research workers who are troubled by complicated spreadsheets, enabling them to have more time for thinking and creative work.
